overall_narrative_summary: Full text not accessible for target study S740; no risk-of-bias appraisal of Asthana (2003) was performed. A retrieval mismatch occurred: although the record header identifies S740 (RD8B9CAF4C5DA) as Asthana AN (2003), 'Decentralisation and Supply Efficiency: The case of Rural Water Supply in Central India', Journal of Development Studies 39(4) (DOI: 10.1080/713601203), the provided source PDF full text (16 pages) is actually Dennis A. Rondinelli (1991), 'Decentralizing water supply services in developing countries: factors affecting the success of community management', Public Administration and Development, Vol. 11, pp. 415-430. Per review protocol, study design and risk-of-bias ratings cannot be guessed from the target citation or title, so paper_read is set to 'not accessible' and chosen_tool, overall_rating, and all seven cross-tool domains are set to 'cannot_tell'. For reconciliation completeness, the attached Rondinelli (1991) paper itself is a non-systematic narrative policy overview synthesizing illustrative secondary project evaluations (WHO, WASH, UNDP, World Bank, DANIDA) without primary empirical data collection or a systematic search/screening protocol, which would map to 'NONE' rather than AMSTAR 2 or an empirical checklist if it were the intended record.
